title: Loss of ERG function causes lymphatic vessel malformations and primary lymphoedema
authors: Pirri D; Maude H; Stroobants A; Ogmem K; Sackey E; Dobbins S; Grigoriadis D; Del Rey Jimenez JC; Al-Ansari DE; Frudd K; Saginc G; Peghaire C; Sutanto S; Vujic T; Moy R; Gresham DO; Manolias A; Nagy D; Riches K; Dean J; Turner CL; Ellard S; Elmslie F; Keeley V; Jeffery S; Mortimer P; Gordon K; Paschalaki KE; Mäkinen T; Celiz A; Gould IR; Mansour S; Martin-Almedina S; Randi AM; Cebola I; Ostergaard P; Birdsey GM
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ERG转录因子功能缺失导致淋巴管畸形，涉及DNA结合与转录调控，但以湿实验和表型为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联有限。
abstract: Transcription factor networks are crucial for the regulation of endothelial cell gene expression during vascular development and homeostasis. A recent analysis of 269 rare diseases in 77,539 individuals revealed an association between loss-of-function variants in ERG, encoding an ETS transcription factor, with primary lymphoedema. However, the pathogenicity of such variants and possible mechanisms of ERG-associated lymphatic vessel dysfunction remains to be established. Here, we have further identified and characterised lymphoedema-associated ERG genetic variants, revealing pathogenic mechanisms ranging from differential ERG subcellular localisation to altered DNA-binding and impaired transactivation. We confirm a role for ERG in regulating lymphangiogenesis using in vitro assays and a lymphatic endothelium-specific Erg deletion mouse model. Furthermore, we characterise the transcriptional and epigenomic landscape of human dermal lymphatic endothelial cells, identifying a unique role for ERG in regulating lymphatic gene programs, including the establishment of cooperative TF networks with PROX1 and GATA2. Our studies identify ERG as a master regulator of lymphatic endothelial cell transcriptional networks and uncover the mechanisms that underpin a novel causative gene for primary lymphoedema.
abstract_zh: 转录因子网络对于血管发育和稳态过程中内皮细胞基因表达的调控至关重要。最近一项对77,539名个体中269种罕见疾病的分析揭示，编码ETS转录因子的ERG基因功能缺失变异与原发性淋巴水肿相关。然而，此类变异的致病性及ERG相关淋巴管功能障碍的可能机制仍有待确定。在此，我们进一步识别并表征了与淋巴水肿相关的ERG遗传变异，揭示了从ERG亚细胞定位差异到DNA结合改变及反式激活受损的致病机制。我们通过体外实验和淋巴内皮特异性Erg缺失小鼠模型，确认了ERG在调控淋巴管生成中的作用。此外，我们表征了人真皮淋巴内皮细胞的转录和表观基因组景观，确定了ERG在调控淋巴基因程序中的独特作用，包括与PROX1和GATA2建立协同转录因子网络。我们的研究将ERG确定为淋巴内皮细胞转录网络的主调控因子，并揭示了支撑原发性淋巴水肿新致病基因的机制。
